title: Khalida's Corruption BETA
author: Zanithor
description:
Khalida, Queen of Lybaras, seeks the wisdom of her Goddess, Asaph. Chaos and Vermin surrounds her ancient kingdom, and needs guidance. She prepares a great ritual to communicate with the Gods, yet little does she knows what the dark Prince has prepared for her..

Scheme and trap the ancient Queen of Lybaras, capture, train and use her as you wish.

This a questline/corruption mod for Khalida, inspired by SOBORO's artwork and Kerberos' mods. Supports Azazel, N'kari, Bel'akor, Archaon and Sigvald.

It follows SOBORO's storyline and it will expand as the story continues.

Currently in BETA, so your feedback is much appreciated.

This mod pairs well with my latest mod: Prince Zanithor <https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/52134-prince-zanithor/>.

It is designed to be standalone, no dependencies on any other mod.

Credits:

- SOBORO: the amazing artwork that is used in this mod

- Kerberos <https://www.loverslab.com/profile/1140051-kerberos-2/>: for the previous corruption framework that supported this mod

- Zeta0080: The skins used in this mods

- TheManWhoPlans <https://www.loverslab.com/profile/9976105-themanwhoplans/>: the community besatmen mods provided the material for the custom skil-trees
